backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profiles, feedback submission, and discussion threads with validation and permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing a branding‑update feature impacting specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A mapping of frontend file paths to brief descriptions of their purpose for build planning.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and theme definitions for light and dark modes using a warm color palette.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file setting the document title to ClashRoyaleHub and loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling client‑side page routing, layout, theming, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ContentSection.t: Simple wrapper component applying prose styling to content sections.
frontend/src/components/discussions/Comm: Renders nested comment threads with timestamps and reply functionality using recursive components.
frontend/src/components/discussions/NewC: Form for adding new comments or replies with validation, authentication checks, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/discussions/NewT: Form to create new discussion threads with title/content validation and mutation submission.
frontend/src/components/FeedbackForm.tsx: Interactive feedback form with validation and mutation handling via React Query.
frontend/src/components/FredWelcomeIntro: Welcome screen for Fred chat showing topic cards and a button to start chatting.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout component providing navigation, mobile menu, header/footer, and admin link handling based on user role.
frontend/src/content/disclaimer.ts: Exports static legal and disclaimer text regarding site affiliation and content usage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actors, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: React-query hooks for fetching threads, fetching a single thread, creating threads, and adding comments.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading identities, handling login/logout, and managing auth state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for fetching user role, user profile, and feedback via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionFlag.ts: React hook that stores a boolean flag in sessionStorage and syncs it with component state.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitFeedback.ts: Mutation hook that submits feedback via an actor and refreshes feedback queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page showing site mission, legal notice, and disclaimers with styled cards.
frontend/src/pages/AdminFeedbackPage.tsx: Admin panel that checks identity and role, then displays user feedback with loading and access states.
frontend/src/pages/BeginnerGuidePage.tsx: Beginner guide with cards explaining elixir, tower mechanics, and basic strategy.
frontend/src/pages/DeckTipsPage.tsx: Deck tips page listing example decks with stats, gameplans, strengths, and weaknesses.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Renders a discussions interface with thread list, thread details, timestamps, comment counts, and forms for posting threads and comments.
frontend/src/pages/FredChatPage.tsx: Implements a chat UI for interacting with Fred, managing messages, intro display, user input, and deterministic responses.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the main landing page with a hero section, links to official Clash Royale resources, and introductory game information.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeBase.ts: Provides Fred’s deterministic response logic, including safety checks, greeting/thanks detection, help prompts, and topic-based answers.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeTopics.t: Defines structured topic data for Fred, including keywords, synonyms, categories, and detailed preset answers.
frontend/src/utils/fredMatcher.ts: Implements text normalization, tokenizing, synonym expansion, and scoring logic to match user input to the best knowledge topic.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage hash-based query cleanup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s current state, requirements, known issues, and feature definitions for site development.
